paite: TOUPA kiang a kipahthu gen leh Tungnungpen aw, na min phat a lasak thil hoih ahi.
heading: Sabbath Phatna La
english: A Psalm. A song for the Sabbath day. It is a good thing to give thanks to Yahweh, to sing praises to your name, Most High,

paite: Zingsang a na zahngaihna hihlat leh, zan teng a na ginomna hihlat,
english: to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night,

paite: thil tumtheih gui sawm neite, pekgingte, kaihging tum khasiathuaite toh, ahoih hi.
english: with the ten-stringed lute, with the harp, and with the melody of the lyre.

paite: TOUPA, nang nna na sep in na hon kipaksak a, na khut thilhihte ziak in nuam in la ka sa ding hi.
english: For you, Yahweh, have made me glad through your work. I will triumph in the works of your hands.

paite: TOUPA aw, na thilhihte thupi hi na tel e! Na ngaihtuahnate thuk hi na lawmlawm e!
english: How great are your works, Yahweh! Your thoughts are very deep.

paite: Mimawl in hiai athei kei hi; mihai in atheisiam sam kei hi.
english: A senseless man doesn’t know, neither does a fool understand this:

paite: Migilou-saloute loupa bang a ahong nou ua, thil hihkhialte tengteng a hong phat letlot un, tangtawn a ding ahihman a hong om ding uh ahi, chih.
english: though the wicked spring up as the grass, and all the evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.

paite: TOUPA aw, nang zaw tangtawn a ding a sangpi a om gige na hi.
english: But you, Yahweh, are on high forever more.

paite: TOUPA aw, ngai dih, nang hon doute, ngai dih, nang hon doute amangthang dek uhi; thil hihkhial tengteng hihzak in a-om vek ding uhi.
english: For behold, your enemies, Yahweh, for behold, your enemies shall perish. All the evildoers will be scattered.

paite: Himahleh gam bawngtal kii bang in ka kii na pahtawi a; sathau thak ka nilhta hi.
english: But you have exalted my horn like that of the wild ox. I am anointed with fresh oil.

paite: Ka mit in leng ka galte tung a ka thudeih amu dia, ka bil in kei hon dou gilou- saloute tung a ka thudeih aza ding.
english: My eye has also seen my enemies. My ears have heard of the wicked enemies who rise up against me.

paite: Midiktat tum sing bang in akhanpha ding a; Lebanon tang a sidar sing bang in akhang huthut ding hi.
english: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree. He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

paite: TOUPA' inn a suan a omte i Pathian huangsung intual ah akhanpha ding uhi.
english: They are planted in Yahweh’s house. They will flourish in our God’s courts.

paite: Upat nung in leng agah lailai ding ua; tuipai kiihkeih in ahing dipdip ding uhi.
english: They will still produce fruit in old age. They will be full of sap and green,

paite: TOUPA diktat ahi chih theihsakna ding in; amah ka suangpi ahi a, amah ah diktatlouhna himhim a-om kei hi.
english: to show that Yahweh is upright. He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
